title: User email validation on registration
description: Add server-side email validation to the user registration flow. Currently the system accepts malformed email addresses, which causes downstream delivery failures. The validation should run before the user record is persisted.
acceptance_criteria: Write a function that validates user email format using a regex pattern that covers RFC 5321 addresses. Call this function from the registration controller before saving the user record.

metadata.intent: Prevent malformed email addresses from entering the user database.
